reviews.comment: Proof-heavy lectures with lots of examples and light homework load. Tests are very similar to homework. Good lecturer and very approachable, willing to help. Flexible and will go out of his way to get the class average as high as he can. Least intimidating math course ever thanks to him.

Dr. Matos is a great teacher. He has amazing lectures and really helps you in office hours. He doesn't provide good notes if you miss class, but his lectures make up for it. Grades mostly on tests, with a few homework assignments. Dr. Matos class actually seemed to make people want to ask questions in class. He is also a fair (not easy) grader.

Dr. Matos's class was very enjoyable. He made sure to explain everything in different ways and worked different example problems during class to ensure that we had seen the material from multiple perspectives. He didn't give much homework, and the final was worth a very significant portion of the final grade. He gave thorough reviews before exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: the best for linear algebra. slows down so the class actually understands it & is a very fair grader! he creates a great review for all of the exams & he also has very reasonable exams.

This class was fun and Professor Matos makes it easy to understand. He is very clear and goes at a good pace in his lectures. The test are very similar to the homework and review, as long as you pay attention and understand the basic concepts you will be fine. I highly recommend him for math 304. Good luck.

Matos is the rare intuitive thinker who can actually explain how to think about a topic. Took him for linear algebra, and I tell my friends that after I got done with this class, I could look at a matrix equation and tell you that it represents a parallelogram. Idk if that's even a thing, but he has phenomenal lectures and makes math exhilerating.
Probably the best lecturer Ive ever had, my favorite proffesor so far, tests were very easy if you study the material he tells you to study (practice tests are VERY similar to tests)

Hes one of the boys. He cares about his students, he is probably one of the nicest people I have ever met, and he is actually extremely smart. The textbook is extremely difficult and he breaks it down as best as possible. 409 is a hard class, but if you take Matos, you will get an A or B i promise.

He has been my favorite professor so far. He actually cares about his students and his test are not too bad considering 409 is notorious for being the most challenging class. He makes things clear and is the best teacher for this subject. If you wanna take this class, only take it if HE is teaching.

Matos a homie fr fr. He's funny, nice, & willing to listen to your struggles. He's a younger prof & wicked smart but still knows how to relate.
Weekly hw, 20% of the grade, from Kenneth Ross' "Elementary Analysis: The Theory of Calculus", all on Chegg.
2 midterms, 25% each, w/ 5 proofs similar to reviews. Cumulative final, 30%, similar difficulty.

Dr. Matos is very clear with what he expects from you as a student. He is also very clear about which concepts he is going to be primarily testing on. His examples done in class are very detailed and easy to follow. Probably the best math professor I have had at A&M. He is very good at explaining the more difficult parts of the class.

Wanna pass, take this man, clear and precise, straight to the point most of the time, not too much hw. Everything in this class is super clear on what to do and all. Replies to emails pretty quick too. Get this man if possible. I honestly have a lot of good things to say but just take him and you'll appreciate this man

ECON 323 is a proof-heavy class but Matos limited the amount of proofs we actually had to do by ourselves by working out proofs together in class but barely giving proofs on the exams. He is very caring and even offered us chances to get extra points on exams. If you dont like proofs, Matos is a great option to make proof classes less difficult

One of the few professors I actually have genuinely enjoyed in my entire time at college. Lessons are clear and concise, transferring quickly from theory to plenty of example problems. Little work, and homeworks only cover what is needed for the tests. Study the test reviews heavily and the homeworks, tests are an easy A. Amazing Prof

Prof. Matos has the rare gift of being able to make math intuitive and easy to understand. He proves things just enough to let you understand the topic, but not so much that you're like, "oh no, proofs". Greta teacher and barely any homework.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is so organized. The professor is caring and gives you doable homework and tests. The exam is not hard at all if you do the review he provided.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lectures perfectly explain the material, and are reinforced by the homework. If you go to class, ask questions, and do the homework and test-reviews, you'll breeze through this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures
